name: Booth Grunt Rush
hook: Crank Tom's mic gain before his chaotic grunt explodes the soundboard
tagline: As the multiplier climbs, an impeccably groomed NFL analyst lets out increasingly bizarre involuntary grunts, gasps, and primal squeals directly into the headset. Cashing out drops the studio cough-button just in time for clean commercial transition music. Crashing unleashes an ear-piercing subwoofer belch that detonates all mixing desk meters across prime time television.
